title: Count business days
description: Implement business_days(start, end, holidays=()). start, end and each holiday are ISO dates 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Return the number of Monday-Friday days in the half-open range [start, end) that are not listed in holidays. If end < start raise ValueError. Invalid dates raise ValueError.
invariants: start is counted, end is not.
Holidays that fall on a weekend or outside the range are ignored and must not be double-subtracted; duplicate holidays count once.
end earlier than start raises ValueError.
